name: epic-observation
description: Live, scrubbable Epic Observation page for any project-management tool (Linear, Jira, monday.com, GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Asana, ClickUp…): replayable timeline, % done, burn-up with forecast band, blocked-by dependency cascade, PR/MR review verdicts, evidence grid and linked event log. One tool-agnostic template; tool specifics live in a per-project tracker profile.
